tools.name: HTML5 + CSS + vanilla JS
tools.reason: Matches the existing starter architecture, needs no build step or hosting account, runs from file://, smallest accessibility and maintenance surface.

tools.name: React / Vue / Svelte
tools.reason: Would force a rewrite of a working static site and add a build pipeline the requirements do not need.

tools.name: Tailwind CSS
tools.reason: Existing hand-written stylesheet is small and was preserved; adopting Tailwind needs a build step.

tools.name: JSON + fetch() for portfolio
tools.reason: fetch() fails on file:// in browsers. A JS data file keeps the 'open index.html' workflow working.

tools.name: Formspree / EmailJS / backend mail
tools.reason: Requirements forbid external commercial APIs and forbid claiming email delivery.

tools.name: Python unittest + Node test runner + Playwright
tools.reason: unittest was already used by the starter; node:test checks the same JS logic the browser runs; Playwright verifies real keyboard, focus and viewport behaviour and captures screenshots.

tools.name: Git
tools.reason: Local baseline commit of the original snapshot, then a feature branch and commit so the diff is reviewable.

plan: Snapshot original files and create a local Git baseline
Add nav toggle markup, portfolio grid, contact form, CTA card to index.html
Append new styles (focus, cards, form, mobile nav) without rewriting existing CSS
Add data/projects-data.js and original SVG assets
Rewrite app.js with pure, testable helpers and progressive enhancement
Add static, Node and Playwright tests; capture desktop/mobile screenshots
limitations: GitHub remote was not accessible (no valid credentials in this environment), so the branch was NOT pushed and no Draft PR exists.
The DOCX in Google Drive was not read directly; requirements came from text pasted in chat.
Base branch name 'main' is inferred from the ZIP name.
Contact form is a local demo and sends nothing.
Mobile/desktop verification used headless Chromium only; Firefox/WebKit and real devices were not tested.
No automated colour-contrast audit (axe) was run; contrast was chosen to meet AA but not machine-verified.
The OpenAI/OpenCode/n8n agent integrations in the LTID platform are structural placeholders; this build was produced by Claude in a Claude Code session, not by the platform itself.
